headline: Did the Zodiac Kill the Black Dahlia? This Crime Writer Thinks So.
context: The novelist Michael Connelly knows he is putting his reputation on the line with the podcast “Killer in the Code.” But despite critics’ skepticism, he finds the evidence “completely convincing.”
